answer: Proposed rule: one daily AI vote on terrace restoration for raven and sparrow habitat requires 2^24 sequential squarings. Validators verify a VDF proof seeded by the key and a fresh daily beacon; invalid or reused proofs get no vote. Each key needs its own chain: n keys require n*2^24 squarings. Parallelism cuts elapsed time, not total work. Electricity recurs; processors are reusable capital. A cross-chain shortcut, setup trapdoor or colluding validators can break the bound. Wealth still buys more votes.
